pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal dark regions with high edge contrast and sharp vertex angles on the upper flank. Patch spatial area decreases and edge complexity increases towards the ventral and caudal regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous interconnected network of light-colored pathways. Junction nodes primarily feature tri-radial intersections. Pathway pixel thickness is relatively uniform across the central flank, narrowing towards the lower limbs.
